subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard support durable, replayable status-transition notifications beyond the bounded card-event history, and if so which persistent event contract should own their scope, ordering, and retention?
rationale: The current implementation can be made mechanically safer, but choosing between durable notification rows, a retained transition log, or an explicitly best-effort recent-history feature determines the permanent storage and compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt a durable transition contract
options.body: Persist immutable transition records or notification rows with transition-time scope and stable ordering, then project subscribers from that source.

options.title: Make it explicitly best-effort
options.body: Keep the bounded history projection but remove durable/replay claims and document its retention and scoping limits.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the new event until downstream consumers and retention semantics have an approved Workboard contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt a durable transition contract
recommendation.body: Persist immutable transition records or notification rows with transition-time scope and stable ordering, then project subscribers from that source.

likelyOwner.reason: A Workboard-area owner should decide the persistent event and plugin-contract boundary before contributors implement a migration-sensitive design.
